profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer
profile.summary: Avid Full-Stack Web Developer with a particular passion for writing clean code and intuitive design. Proficient on Javascript, ReactJS, REST APIs, CI/CD, Unit Testing, Serverless, AWS,  NodeJS, Express, Bootstrap, Git/Github, CSS, HTML. Exceptionally passionate about creating, optimizing & organizing.

positions.title: Full Stack Development Fellow
positions.description:
Selected for Pursuit Core Fellowship, an intensive 10-month, Google-funded software engineering program with a 9% acceptance rate (out of 1500+ applicants). Fellows are prepared with in-demand technical and professional skills and have been hired as developers at leading companies such as Pinterest, JP Morgan, and Spotify. 

Gained hands-on experience with NodeJS, Git/GitHub, Data Structures, Algorithms, APIs, and tech principles and culture via both team/individual projects, code reviews, and pair programming.

positions.title: Store Manager
positions.description:
Managed a group of 5+ staff members. Trained potential newcomers and offered help whenever it was requested by any of the team members.

Showed initiative to implement new methods and take on responsibilities that were not initially part of my job description. Responsible for insurance - billing method that ensured precision and raised the store’s yearly revenue by up to 5%.

Handled conflicts with customers in an efficient and professional way, ensuring the customer was happy and the company did not lose any revenue.
